'''Karsim''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Karsim was later recruited into the [[Republic Special Forces Division]]'s [[Special Forces black ops program|black ops program]] as part of the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] known as the [[Surgeons]], though the squad was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berrun]] after it started hunting the families of enemy targets.

==Biography==
{{Quote|They were good soldiers. Far better than any of the others I've had under my command.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="The Surgeons" />}}
[[File:Fideltin_Rusk.png|thumb|right|200px|Sergeant Fideltin Rusk, Karsim's commanding officer]]
A [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]'s [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Bad Intel" /> Karsim<ref name="Vanished">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Vanished}}</ref> served in a [[Surgeons|squad]] under the [[Commander/Legends|command]] of the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]], and its first [[Attack on an Imperial outpost|mission]] was to free several [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war from an [[Imperial outpost (prison camp)|Imperial outpost]]. However, intelligence on the mission was incorrect, forcing the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] to fight through more enemy forces than it expected. Despite its disadvantage, the squad was able to rescue all of the prisoners and escape with heavy injuries, without a single [[Death/Legends|fatality]].<ref name="Bad Intel" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following that mission, Karsim was among the squad members who were recruited into the [[Republic Special Forces Division]]'s [[Special Forces black ops program|black ops program]], and the squad&mdash;which included fellow veterans [[Naja]] and [[Eckerd]]&mdash;was tasked with the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of Imperial leaders by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]]. The squad, which became known as the "Surgeons," soon began to go after its targets' families. Karsim and the others were arrested for war crimes and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in a [[Berrun detention center|detention center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berrun]] with life sentences.<ref name="The Surgeons" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Good soldiers know what acceptable targets are. This wouldn't have happened on my watch.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="The Surgeons" />}}
A loyal soldier, Karsim's [[Time/Legends|time]] in the Special Forces black ops program turned the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] into a killer who no longer respected the moral code of warfare. Sergeant Rusk was disturbed to learn that his former squadmates had crossed the line and targeted [[Gender/Legends|women]] and children, and was disappointed that Karsim and the others&mdash;whom he had considered the best soldiers to ever serve under him&mdash;had changed so much.<ref name="The Surgeons" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karsim was first mentioned by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Fideltin Rusk in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Surgeons" />
